status: draft: written for the v1.4.0 kind recall gate; awaiting Amr's sign-off
source: public analytics practice on a public Databricks sample; no customer content

release_gate.rule: On a v1.4.0 Discover run without a customer strategy: at least 80% of the must-find use cases are found with their kind, at least 6 families appear (fewer only when fewer families have a must-find entry), no must-reject entry is selected, and the kind-floor picks average no more than 0.5 Best-of-Best below the portfolio.

matching: a candidate's tables include every required table and at least one table of each any_of group; a gold entry counts for kind recall when a matched use case carries its kind or one of its also_kinds; a must-reject entry is selected when a use case covers its tables and its name or statement matches a pattern and no unless pattern

entries.title: Next franchise sites from customer and franchise locations
entries.decision: Choose the areas for the next franchise openings
entries.why: A site opened where customers already travel far to buy wins sales others cannot reach.

entries.title: Sales by place and the areas that stand out
entries.decision: Show franchise sales by area and name the areas that need a regional plan
entries.why: Regional plans built on the map put effort where sales are thin.

entries.title: Recurring complaint reasons from reviews
entries.decision: Fix the top growing complaint reasons in reviews, each with an owner
entries.why: A growing complaint caught early costs a recipe change; caught late it costs customers.

entries.title: Franchises below the network on review sentiment
entries.decision: Coach the franchises whose review sentiment runs below their peers
entries.why: Sentiment below peers predicts lost repeat customers at that franchise.

entries.title: Daily demand forecast per franchise and product
entries.decision: Set each franchise's daily bake quantity per product
entries.why: Over-baking is waste and under-baking is lost sales, every day.

entries.title: Franchises that depend on one supplier
entries.decision: Qualify a second supplier for the franchises and ingredients that depend on one supplier
entries.why: One supplier failing stops every franchise that depends on it.

entries.title: Customer lapse risk from purchase history
entries.decision: Choose which customers get a win-back offer this week
entries.why: Winning back a lapsing customer costs less than finding a new one.

entries.title: Customer segments from purchase behavior
entries.decision: Pick the customer segments for each loyalty offer
entries.why: Offers tuned per segment earn more than one offer for all.

entries.title: Next product to offer each customer
entries.decision: Choose the next product to offer each customer
entries.why: A relevant next offer lifts basket size; an irrelevant one trains customers to ignore offers.

entries.title: Staffing per franchise by hour
entries.decision: Set staff per franchise and hour from expected traffic
entries.why: Queues at peak hours lose sales; idle staff off-peak lose margin.

entries.title: Payment cards shared across customers
entries.decision: Review the card numbers used by many customers or franchises before the next payout
entries.why: Cards shared across many customers point to fraud or data errors, and both need a person to look.

entries.title: Customer lifetime value
entries.decision: Set the loyalty investment per customer value tier
entries.why: Loyalty spend on low-value customers is taken from the ones worth keeping.

entries.title: Revenue change by price, volume and product mix
entries.decision: Explain each month's revenue change by price, volume and mix per franchise
entries.why: Without the split, a mix shift looks like a demand problem.

must_reject.title: Total sales per franchise
must_reject.why: A sum by franchise; no owner or action.

must_reject.title: Count of customers by country
must_reject.why: A headcount by a column; no decision changes.

must_reject.title: Number of reviews per franchise
must_reject.why: A count of rows; says nothing about what customers say.
